turns.body: Hi! I ordered a stand mixer last week. Can I still change the delivery address?
Yes, as long as the parcel has not left our warehouse. Orders ship the next working day, so tell me your order number and I will check where it is.
Order 10492. The new address is Nygata 3, Lillevik.
The mixer arrived today but the bowl has a dent in the rim. Can I get a replacement bowl rather than sending the whole thing back?
Could you resend the invoice for order 10488? Our finance team never received it.
The invoice for order 10488 is on its way to this address again. Let me know if it still does not arrive.
Does the knife block fit in a standard kitchen drawer?
The block is 34 cm tall, so it sits on the worktop rather than in a drawer. There is a separate drawer insert that holds the same six knives.
We are refitting 40 hotel rooms and need pricing on kettles and toasters in that volume.
Is the enamel on the cast iron pan covered by the warranty?
Manufacturing faults in the enamel are covered for five years. Chips that come from everyday use count as wear and are covered for the first year.
